name: async-race-condition
description: Identify and fix a race condition in async code

promptLevels.beginner: identify the race condition bug in the UserManager class
promptLevels.intermediate: analyze the UserManager code and explain the race condition that occurs when fetchUsers and addUser are called simultaneously

languageInstructions.typescript: Provide detailed analysis as markdown or structured response. Include corrected TypeScript code using techniques like Promise queuing, operation IDs to track requests, or mutex/lock patterns. Explain trade-offs of each solution.
languageInstructions.javascript: Provide analysis and corrected JavaScript code. Show solutions like maintaining a pending operations queue, adding request identifiers, or implementing a simple mutex pattern using Promises.
languageInstructions.javascript-jsdoc: Provide analysis with JSDoc-annotated corrected code. Document the concurrency strategy used, include @async tags, and explain how the solution prevents race conditions.
